svg.title: Who decides, by Change-Class
svg.desc: For each Change-Class (docs, refactor, feature, schema): whether the light lane applies, who approves the spec in supervised and autonomous mode, which risk label the receipt suggests, and who merges. A person approves every spec in supervised mode and merges every pull request.
svg.text: ADR-002: enforced in risk, approve and the light lane
DECLARED IN THE SPEC · ↓ MORE ASSURANCE
IF THE USER SWITCHED IT ON
Markdown and other doc files; code
Rename or extract, with no change in
New or changed requirements, and any
A risk term, a risk path or an ADR that isn't Accepted makes any spec not low-risk.
An unknown Change-Class, or two values, fails spec-check; the receipt labels it class:feature.
At finish, a policy-approved change that touched a sensitive path, more than 20 files or, for docs,
anything but documentation is refused until it is escalated.
The light lane needs the user's (light) mark and at most 3 requirements and criteria and 3 changed
files. It skips the architect and the griller; approval, the judge and verify still apply.
Under a no-merge profile only a person merges: orca --merge and --trust, nightly runs and enroll
Labels go on the PR for triage: the highest risk:* among its tasks, which only goes up, and each
Sources: ADR-002 and backbone/HOOKS.md (risk, light lane, change receipt) at v0.32.0.
A spec without a Change-Class line counts as feature.
